name: birthday
provisos: Tim must not find out about this.
Whoever forgets owes the group a round.
This can change on the day if the weather turns.
Somebody should text the group when it is done.
Sam has the final say on anything to do with the flat.
Allergies go in the group chat by Thursday.
Nothing here stops anyone bringing a plus-one, within reason.
This is a suggestion, not a rule, if Tim's mum comes.
Photos of this stay off the internet.
newClauses: Somebody brings a speaker that actually works.
We put up bunting and at least one balloon arch, however tacky.
There is a jug of something non-alcoholic that is not just orange juice.
Somebody is on door duty so Tim does not walk in on the setup.
Fairy lights on the balcony, weather permitting.
We take one group photo before anybody has had a drink.
There is a birthday hat, and Tim wears it for the cake at least.
Leo brings the good glasses from his place.
We book a taxi for Tim at the end so he is not the one sorting it out.
Somebody writes down every embarrassing story told, for the card next year.
A quiet corner is kept for anyone who needs a breather.
Whoever arrives first puts the kettle on.

proviso: Otherwise this goes wrong the moment Tim asks a question.
Learned this the hard way last year.
number: More is more, it's a birthday.
Fewer, or we will never eat it all.
modal: Nobody will actually do this if we make it a rule.
Softer, we are friends not a committee.
rewrite: It is Tim's day, he gets a veto.
delete: We won't do this and we know it.
insert: Somebody has to be on this or it won't happen.
split: Two jobs hiding in one sentence.
Easier to argue about one half.
motion: Worth a try for this one.
Eight of us don't need the strict version.
